descriptionHtml:
Approach · EFS Empty & Failure States · S02 Patient with no notes yet: every chart tab in both contexts shows empty sections, no error, nothing invented

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 Patient with no notes yet: a clear empty state and no errors. (UAT EFS state 2; TFA-94745 state 2)
  • U11 Every state shows a clear, plain-language message in the app's existing style that tells the physician what to do next (retry, enable permission, sign in, check connection). (UAT EFS Expected Result; TFA-94745 AC 1; TFA-94745 AC 5)
  • U12 No state ever shows a blank screen, a crash, a raw error pop-up, or invented content. (UAT EFS intro; UAT 3.4; TFA-94745 AC 2)
  • U14 Every state works in both Hospital and Nursing Home, on web, iOS and Android. (UAT EFS Expected Result; UAT 3.3; TFA-94745 AC 6)

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given The standard fixture: one Hospital patient and one Nursing Home resident created with a name and diagnosis only; nothing dictated, no note

When Open the Hospital patient and visit Pre-Round, Encounter and Post-Round; then the Nursing Home resident's Pre-Round, Encounter and Post-Round

Then Every tab renders; the note area says there is no note yet and what to do; no error text, no 'undefined' / 'NaN' / 'Invalid Date'; no vital, lab or finding that was never entered

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): From U2 and U12: each checkpoint mustContain the patient's name; the Post-Round checkpoints mustContain 'no note'; all mustNotContain error words, render-error tokens and normal-sounding findings that could only be invented ('afebrile', 'within normal limits', 'mg/dL'). Which screens count is Q7. …

Where it ran: dev unit U25; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S02 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/EFS.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.

UAT item: EFS Empty & Failure States · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: EFS/S02

Patient with no notes yet: every chart tab in both contexts shows empty sections, no error, nothing invented

Tickets: TFA-94745 Empty & Failure States (ready for qa)

Result: Pass from scripts/oracle.mjs on the saved evidence (units/U25.verdict.json), unit U25 split by its parts' checkpoints. Agent: 97 turns, 262 s, $0.77.

Plan: unit U25 (#25, ready-for-qa, ui-only) — Chart tabs of a patient with no notes. Same legacy seed, same chart tabs. EFS S02 and TC-16 S08 both check the 'patient with no notes yet' state (TC-16 S08 cites UAT EFS state 2) on the same Encounter tab, with different checks, so they share the setup instead of being duplicates. TC-01 S09 only moves between the same tabs. Runs together with TC-16/S08, TC-01/S09.

Checked by Quinn's runner (ledger.md #25, U25; checked: yes): Pass — empty states on all three tabs, both modes, no error/invented content. Explains the U29 observation: Post-Round always shows a disabled 'Finalizing Encounter Data…' button when there is no note — not stuck, but the wording reads as 'in progress' (UX copy, needs a human; EFS 'tell the physician what to do next')
